evidence: Source reads and edits only; no builds, tests, syntax checks, archive execution/round trips, game launch, attachment or process inspection

archive.block: magic u64, frame count u32; each frame: time f64, tick i64, tick rate f32, strict u8 presence; optional sample follows
archive.sample: DataOutput UTF dimension, strict u8 camera-relative flag, six f64 camera fields, sixteen f32 projection fields, then 1058 f32 shader values
archive.shaderOrder: lightmap 1024 RGBA floats, ColorModulator 4, light directions 6, fog-position affine transform 12, selected overlay texel 4, fog color 4, fog ranges 4
archive.ownership: Samples retain the already copied immutable JavaEntityShader and clone camera/projection context; no native pointers or mutable input arrays survive
archive.writer: Observe at appearance-history start, each recording sample and finish; flush through the existing serialized compressed asset writer
archive.reader: Validate bounded decompression, clock/order, presence flags, source context, shader array values, matching block index, no trailing data and unchanged archive manifest on reload

playback.endpoints: Use the exact recorded material at an exact observation time
playback.interior: Require neighboring observations with equal shader values, compatible dimension/space/context, no missed tick, contiguous chunks and no long pause; otherwise unknown
playback.standardCameraEdits: For camera-relative world positions with an exactly identity fog-position transform, entity.vsh fog derives from emitted Position before ModelViewMat. Re-emission under the edited replay camera supplies its new relative positions; the archived material can be reused without an invented affine transform.
playback.otherTransforms: Require bit-identical recorded camera and projection context; generalized fog-space camera rebasing remains unfinished
playback.renderer: WorldFrame.render selects the archived material during replay appearance; it never substitutes a live viewer profile
playback.capture: Appearance readiness requires an available recorded material for actors requiring recorded body references
playback.legacy: Archives without the new optional track still mount, but lack recorded material readiness
